mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS level shows no correlation with 20-day S&P 500 returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals a favorable monetary environment for equities, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL < 2.0%
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS fall > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST level shows no correlation with 5-day S&P 500 returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1400) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) signals a strong economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: strong economic growth with accommodative policy
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST > 1400 and FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of weak industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to reduced corporate earnings growth and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
